name: flags
meaning: bit 0x1 = someone else already froze the Wolf, do not freeze (Update tests !(flags&1) at 0x4e1e63 before sending 0xe). 0x2 Wolf dead, 0x100 resizing, 0x200 _MAXIMIZE, 0x400 _EXIT, 0x800 size accepted

name: state
meaning: ResizerState: written by SetState 0x4e22ac, switched on by Update (the byte-matched source reads it here)

name: model
meaning: AltModel: outMain of ScnObject_InitWithAltModels (0x4e2516 add ecx,0x6c)

name: altMaximize
meaning: alt-model entry for id-list 0xbe (0x4e2509 add edx,0x7c is outAlts; 0x4e18c7 SwapModel)

name: startMs
meaning: g_gameTimeMs when the target is frozen in state 1 (Update); the resize waits 500 ms from it

name: camEye
meaning: the scripted camera's eye: pos moved 300 back along the heading and 250 up (PostLoadInit)

name: modelBox
meaning: model box 0, made non-solid while idle and solid while capturing (SetState)

name: activationBox
meaning: PROPERTY_RESIZER_ACTIVATIONBOX (prop 8): the zone Update searches for a target; not read with RESIZER_F_EXIT_ONLY

name: height
meaning: modelBox->min.y - 5: the y at which a captured or ejected object is placed

name: target
meaning: the object being resized: found in activationBox, or handed over by MSG_RESIZER_RECEIVE

name: exitObject
meaning: PROPERTY_RESIZER_EXIT (prop 12): the exit Resizer that receives the resized target (MSG_RESIZER_RECEIVE)
